settings.name: Corner Table
settings.description: A neighborhood restaurant serving seasonal, locally-sourced plates in a warm, unhurried setting. Reservations open daily.
settings.seo_description: Seasonal cooking, neighborhood hospitality. Book a table tonight.
settings.contact_hours: Tue-Thu 5-10pm · Fri-Sat 5-11pm · Sun Brunch 11am-3pm, Dinner 5-9pm · Mon Closed

sections.title: Seasonal plates, quiet conversations.
sections.body: A small dining room on Linden Street where the bread is warm, the wine list is short, and dinner takes as long as it needs to.

sections.title: Where neighbors become regulars.
sections.body: Corner Table opened as a small idea between three friends who wanted to cook the kind of food they'd actually want to eat after a long day. Seven years later we're still here, cooking from a hand-written menu that changes when the produce does, and still pouring the same honest wines we started with.

payload.image_alt: Warm dining room with pendant lights and dark wooden tables

values.title: Seasonal
values.body: We cook with what is in season at the farmers' market down the road.

values.title: Unhurried
values.body: Dinner takes as long as it needs to. We do not flip tables.

values.title: Honest
values.body: Short wine list, real bread, fair prices, no pretense.

sections.title: A short menu, made well.
sections.body: Updated weekly. Ask your server about tonight's specials and seasonal additions.

payload.footnote: Prices in USD. Please tell us about allergies, we are happy to adapt most dishes.

sections.title: A look inside.
sections.body: Plates, the bar, and the dining room at dusk.

sections.title: Hours and location.
sections.body: 412 Linden Street, Riverview, OR. Closed Mondays. Reservations recommended Friday and Saturday.

projects.title: Heirloom Tomato and Burrata
projects.summary: Local tomatoes, creamy burrata, basil oil, finishing salt.
projects.body: A summer staple that we run as long as the tomatoes hold up. The burrata comes from a small dairy two valleys over. Best with a glass of dry rosé.

projects.title: Braised Short Rib
projects.summary: Slow-braised in red wine, creamy polenta, gremolata.
projects.body: Twelve hours in the oven with mirepoix and a bottle of the house red. The polenta is stone-ground from a mill in the next county.

projects.title: Wild Mushroom Risotto
projects.summary: Arborio, foraged mushrooms, aged parmesan, thyme.
projects.body: Mushrooms come from a forager who walks the coastal range. The risotto is finished tableside.

projects.title: Dark Chocolate Tart
projects.summary: 70% chocolate ganache, sea salt, fresh raspberries.
projects.body: A short pastry shell, a generous ganache, and a flake of sea salt. The most-ordered dessert on the menu, for good reason.

posts.title: What is on the menu this week
posts.excerpt: A short note on the dishes we are running this week and why we chose them.
posts.body: The tomatoes are still good and we are running the burrata one more week before the season turns. We have added a roasted-squash starter that we are pretty proud of, and the short rib is back on Friday and Saturday. Reservations are tight this week, please call ahead.
posts.author: Chef Marin
posts.seo_description: What we are cooking this week and why.

posts.title: Where our produce comes from
posts.excerpt: A short tour of the four farms that supply most of what ends up on your plate.
posts.body: Four small farms within an hour of the restaurant grow most of what we cook with. We visit twice a month, place standing orders on Mondays, and adjust the menu based on what is ready that week.
posts.author: Chef Marin
posts.seo_description: A short tour of the four local farms that supply Corner Table.

services.title: Sunday Brunch
services.summary: Eggs benedict, malted waffles, a short brunch menu and bottomless coffee. Served 11am to 3pm Sundays only.
services.details: Brunch is the only time we take walk-ins without a wait. Sit at the bar with a paper if you have not booked.

services.title: Dinner Service
services.summary: Three-course seasonal menu, short wine list, classic cocktails. Tuesday through Sunday evenings.
services.details: Dinner is what we built the place around. Most tables stay for two hours. We do not rush them.

services.title: Bar and Aperitivo
services.summary: Eight stools at the bar, a short list of bottled wines by the glass, and an aperitivo menu from 4pm.
services.details: Walk-ins welcome at the bar. Order a snack and stay for dinner if a table opens up.

services.title: Private Events
services.summary: The whole dining room seats 32. We host birthdays, rehearsal dinners, small wedding parties, and the occasional book launch.
services.details: We will work with you on a custom menu and a wine pairing. Three-week lead time recommended.

testimonials.quote: Our favorite restaurant in the neighborhood. The kind of place you take out-of-town family because you want them to remember the food.
testimonials.author: Lena T.

testimonials.quote: Quiet, warm, and the kitchen never sends out a flat plate. The short rib is worth the trip alone.
testimonials.author: James R.

testimonials.quote: We booked the whole room for our anniversary. They built a menu around our favorites and the wine pairings were perfect.
testimonials.author: Maria and David

testimonials.quote: Brunch at Corner Table is a Sunday ritual. The waffles, the eggs, and a paper at the bar. That is the whole morning.
testimonials.author: Annie K.

faqs.question: Do you take reservations?
faqs.answer: Yes, and we recommend them Thursday through Saturday. The bar is walk-in only. Reservations can be made by phone or through OpenTable.

faqs.question: What time is brunch served?
faqs.answer: Brunch runs from 11am to 3pm on Sundays only. Dinner service then begins at 5pm.

faqs.question: Can you accommodate dietary restrictions?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tell us when you book or when you sit down and we will adapt most dishes. We always have at least one vegetarian and one gluten-free option on each course.

faqs.question: Is there parking nearby?
faqs.answer: Street parking on Linden Street and a public lot one block north on Cherry. The lot is free after 6pm.

faqs.question: Do you host private events?
faqs.answer: Yes. The whole dining room seats 32 and a partial buyout starts at 16. Three-week lead time recommended for custom menus.
